name: AppLocker and WDAC Blocks
description: Application control: AppLocker executables, DLLs, scripts, installers and packaged apps that were blocked or would have been blocked (audit), and Windows Defender Application Control (App Control) audit and block events for images (CodeIntegrity 3076/3077) and for scripts and MSI files (AppLocker log 8028/8029).
author: EventHawk (Microsoft documentation, SANS, Sigma)

event_descriptions.8003: AppLocker: EXE/DLL would have been blocked (audit)
event_descriptions.8006: AppLocker: script/MSI would have been blocked (audit)
event_descriptions.8021: AppLocker: packaged app would have been blocked (audit)
event_descriptions.8024: AppLocker: packaged app installation would have been blocked (audit)
event_descriptions.8028: WDAC: script or MSI would have been blocked (audit mode)
event_descriptions.8029: WDAC: script or MSI blocked (enforced policy)
event_descriptions.3076: WDAC: image would have been blocked (audit mode)
